title: Course Review Analysis
description: Course Review Analysis Application is built using NLP techniques and the BERT model. The project collects and analyzes course reviews, leveraging pre-trained transformers for sentiment classification and generating insights.

title: Domain-based Search Engine
description: This Project is a  simple Search Engine implemented with https://ku.edu as seed page. It includes components web crawling, text preprocessing, stemming, and a ranking mechanism using the Vector Space Model.

title: Budget Tracker Web Application
description: A simple user-friendly app to track expenses. Features include transaction categorization, spending summaries, and interactive charts to visualize financial data, helping users stay on top of their budget.

title: Graduate Admissions Prediction
description: This project predicts the likelihood of graduate admissions using machine learning techniques. By analyzing data like GRE, TOEFL scores, GPA, and other features, evaluated models to predict a candidate's admission chances.
